description: This file is a shell script used to manage a whitelist of MOCA (Multimedia over Coax Alliance) IP addresses. It supports adding, deleting, checking, and displaying entries in a temporary whitelist file, with logic interacting with system-level tools such as 'sysevent', 'grep', 'arp', and so forth.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new IP address to the moca whitelist file if it does not already exist.

methods.name: del
methods.description: Removes an IP address from the moca whitelist file if it exists.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks for proxy ARP entries and warns if they are not in the whitelist.
